# jenkins — 2023 high-value CVEs (CVSS>=7, CISA KEV, Exploit-DB, or SSVC exploitation active/poc)

Full records for all 252 jenkins CVEs of 2023 are in `data/cve/vendors/jenkins/2023.jsonl`.

### CVE-2023-3442 — Missing Authorization in Jenkins plug-in for ServiceNow DevOps
- Assigner: SN | Published: 2023-07-26 | Updated: 2024-10-15 | Max CVSS: 7.7
- CWE: CWE-862 CWE-862 Missing Authorization
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 7.7 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:N/A:N`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=partial

A missing authorization vulnerability exists in versions of the Jenkins Plug-in for ServiceNow DevOps prior to 1.38.1 that, if exploited successfully, could cause the unwanted exposure of sensitive information. To address this issue, apply the 1.38.1 version of the Jenkins plug-in for ServiceNow DevOps on your Jenkins server.  No changes are required on your instances of the Now Platform. 


Affected:
- ServiceNow / Jenkins plug-in for ServiceNow DevOps: affected 0 <1.38.1 (semver)

Credits: Alvaro Muñoz (@pwntester), GitHub Security Lab

References:
- https://support.servicenow.com/kb?id=kb_article_view&sysparm_article=KB1434119

### CVE-2023-24422
- Assigner: jenkins | Published: 2023-01-24 | Updated: 2025-04-02 | Max CVSS: 8.8
- CWE: CWE-78 CWE-78 Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 8.8 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

A sandbox bypass vulnerability involving map constructors in Jenkins Script Security Plugin 1228.vd93135a_2fb_25 and earlier allows attackers with permission to define and run sandboxed scripts, including Pipelines, to bypass the sandbox protection and execute arbitrary code in the context of the Jenkins controller JVM.

Affected:
- Jenkins Project / Jenkins Script Security Plugin: affected unspecified <=1228.vd93135a_2fb_25 (custom); unaffected 1175.1180.v36a_3fb_2dec9c

References:
- https://www.jenkins.io/security/advisory/2023-01-24/#SECURITY-3016

### CVE-2023-24429
- Assigner: jenkins | Published: 2023-01-24 | Updated: 2025-04-02 | Max CVSS: 9.8
- CWE: CWE-611 CWE-611 Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 9.8 CRITICAL `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=total

Jenkins Semantic Versioning Plugin 1.14 and earlier does not restrict execution of an controller/agent message to agents, and implements no limitations about the file path that can be parsed, allowing attackers able to control agent processes to have Jenkins parse a crafted file that uses external entities for extraction of secrets from the Jenkins controller or server-side request forgery.

Affected:
- Jenkins Project / Jenkins Semantic Versioning Plugin: affected unspecified <=1.14 (custom)

References:
- https://www.jenkins.io/security/advisory/2023-01-24/#SECURITY-2973%20%281%29

Jenkins 2.270 through 2.393 (both inclusive), LTS 2.277.1 through 2.375.3 (both inclusive) does not escape the Jenkins version a plugin depends on when rendering the error message stating its incompatibility with the current version of Jenkins, resulting in a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exploitable by attackers able to provide plugins to the configured update sites and have this message shown by Jenkins instances.

Affected:
- Jenkins Project / Jenkins: affected 2.270 <2.* (maven) changes:unaffected@2.375.4;affected@2.376;unaffected@2.387.1;affected@2.388;unaffected@2.394
